title: Free Night Awards Training Q&A: This Year's Elite Nights and the Rebooked Night's Price
content:
**What does the rule provide?**
When a member applies one of the Free Night Awards that came back from a cancelled stay to a night of another Reward Night Rate reservation, the elite-night reduction is the upper rebooking night reduction when this year's elite night credits are at least the upper rebooking night threshold, the lower rebooking night reduction when they are at least the lower rebooking night threshold, and nothing otherwise. It is taken off the rebooked night's price once.

| This year's elite night credits | Elite-night reduction |
|---|---|
| At least 75 (upper rebooking night threshold) | 2000 points (upper rebooking night reduction) |
| At least 50 but fewer than 75 (lower rebooking night threshold) | 1000 points (lower rebooking night reduction) |
| Fewer than 50 | No elite-night reduction |

**What are "this year's elite night credits"?**
The elite night credits accrued in the current calendar year, as the Ashbury Rewards membership record shows them.

**What happens exactly at a threshold?**
Reaching a threshold is enough: 75 credits take 2000 points, 50 credits take 1000 points, and 49 credits take nothing.

**A hypothetical member with 62 credits this year?**
At least 50 and fewer than 75: 1000 points.
